effect: You wake up in a surgical room. Androids transplant your brain onto the body of an android. Set TEC to 3 and all other stats to 0. You have a new random cybertech module installed.
A glitch electrocutes you. All HACKS, cybertech, or any abilities that consume Energy now cost 1x more.
An alien symbiote enters your system. Parts of your body mutate into viscous black fibers. -1 to all stats (can't go below 0). You can no longer escape combat encounters.
Time stops. You see the entirety of human existence. You are 10 years younger. Lose all your cybertech and EXP.
A strange silhouette tends to your wounds. You survive, but in pain. Take 1 damage every time you lose a Challenge Roll (ignoring Armor).
The void swallows your lifeless body. A thousand pale white tentacles pull you into a vortex of crimson light and dark matter. Your character dies.
